info.name: Dastarkhwan Complete API
info.description: Source-verified Postman collection for the Dastarkhwan Web host at origin/master 4c2c748. Covers Identity (15), Access (14), Tenant (22), Health (2) and development-only routes (9). Tenant context is carried by the JWT tenant claim (not an X-Tenant-Id header). Error bodies are RFC 9457 Problem Details with errorCode/traceId. No requests are executed by importing this collection.

pm.test('200 ready or 503 when a database is unreachable', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 503]));
if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.test('status = ready', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('ready')); }
pm.test('200 in development, 404 when not mapped', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 404]));
pm.test('200 in development, 404 when not mapped', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 404]));

pm.test('401 Unauthorized', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
pm.test('Problem Details errorCode present', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property('errorCode'));

D4 Attempt tenant B settings without authorization
